instruction: How to create an OpenStack server with multiple networks
output: openstack server create --nic net-id=private-net --nic net-id=public-net --image debian-12 --flavor m1.small multi-net-instance

How to create a new network with provider type
output: openstack network create --provider-network-type vlan --provider-physical-network physnet1 --provider-segment 100 my-vlan-network

instruction: How to create network with subnet pool
output: openstack subnet create --subnet-pool my-pool --network my-network my-subnet
openstack network create --external --provider-network-type flat --provider-physical-network physnet1 public

instruction: How to create router on external network
How to list port forwarding rules

output: openstack port forwarding create --external-port 8080 --internal-port 80 --internal-port-id PORT_ID --protocol tcp my-router

instruction: How to list all network flavors

output: openstack network flavor create --description 'my flavor' --service-type networking my-flavor

instruction: How to create RBAC policy for network
output: openstack network rbac create --type network --target-project TARGET_PROJECT --action access_as_shared my-network
